notFound.title: No such run
notFound.description: This run is not recorded for a Bot you manage, or it never existed. A transferred or removed run is no longer visible here.

disabled.title: Run tracing is off
disabled.description: Observability is disabled for this deployment, so no runs are recorded. Existing Bot execution is unaffected.

empty.title: No runs yet
empty.description: This Bot has not recorded a run. Start a conversation, then reload this page.

forbidden.title: You cannot observe this Bot
forbidden.description: Observation needs management rights on the Bot. Being able to chat with it, or a public share link, is not enough.

basic.title: Basic coverage only
basic.description: Only what OpenBot itself observed is recorded. Steps inside this remote Agent are not visible, and their absence is not evidence they did not happen.

omitted.title: Content omitted
omitted.description: This field could not be handled safely, so only metrics are shown. Omitted is not the same as empty.

truncated.title: Content truncated
truncated.description: This value exceeds the recorded size limit and was cut. The stored record is shorter than what the run actually produced.

syncing.title: Still syncing
syncing.description: The run finished but its record has not been confirmed upstream yet. Reload shortly.

unavailable.title: Upstream unavailable
unavailable.description: The observability store did not answer. Your conversation result was not affected. This is a fault, not an empty list.

tokenUnavailable.title: Token usage unavailable
tokenUnavailable.description: Token usage could not be read for this run. Unavailable is not zero — the run is not counted as 0 tokens.

page.title: Run history
page.description: Recorded runs of this Bot, as the observability store holds them.

detail.title: Run detail
detail.description: One recorded run of this Bot, as the observability store holds it.

upstream.present: Linked — the store holds this run's upstream record.
upstream.absentDescription: This run reconciled upstream, but the store only serves the most recent runs, so its upstream detail cannot be shown. The run itself is unaffected.

detail.metadataEmpty: No metadata was projected for this run.

steps.empty: No steps were recorded for this run.
steps.basicNote: This run has basic coverage: only what OpenBot itself observed is recorded. Steps inside the remote Agent are not visible, and their absence is not evidence they did not happen.
steps.coverageNote: Coverage is unverified for this run, so no step tree can be vouched for.

filter.loadedPageOnly: Filters apply to the loaded page.
filter.noMatch: No run on this page matches the filters.
